name: OmaWhatsApp
author: MoizIbnYousaf
description: Native WhatsApp for the Omarchy shell, not a browser tab: local-first chats that open instantly, quick replies from the bar, voice notes, media, notifications and several accounts, all in your Omarchy theme. Powered by wacli.

barWidget.description: Open synced direct chats and standalone groups, with unread messages at a glance.
